:::{#def-diagonal-matrix}
#### Diagonal matrix

A square matrix $\matr{D}$ is a **diagonal matrix**
if all off-diagonal entries are zero:
$d_{ij} = 0$ whenever $i \neq j$:

$$
\matr{D} =
\begin{bmatrix}
d_1    & 0      & \cdots & 0      \\
0      & d_2    & \cdots & 0      \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
0      & 0      & \cdots & d_p
\end{bmatrix}
$$

:::
